Use case: stylized-concept, with photorealistic physically based materials.
Asset type: original Elitewake pirate survival game boat hull concept reference, individual transparent cutout.
Primary request: A small primitive rectangular timber raft hull made of thick buoyant rough-hewn logs, transverse structural timbers and believable hemp bindings. Structural lashings are necessary construction, not decorative equipment. Flat empty platform, low freeboard. No mast or sail.
Style: premium 2026 realistic Unreal Engine game asset presentation, original design, convincing naval carpentry and structural construction, detailed natural weathered oak planking, end grain, joints, pegs and restrained structural iron fasteners. Slightly weathered but intact, clean enough to read every hull form. No cartoon or low-poly style.
Composition: ONE boat only, entire hull visible, generous transparent margins, raised three-quarter port-bow camera showing both exterior hull and empty deck/interior, bow toward image left and stern toward right. Centered studio product framing, large clear readable object. Soft neutral studio illumination and natural wood color, no scenery.
Critical design requirement: ships are modular prebuilt BARE HULLS. Include only integral hull/deck structure. Absolutely no sails, masts, rigging, cannons, helm wheels, rudders, anchors, chains, ropes except necessary raft construction lashings, ladders, cargo, lanterns, flags, crew, decorations, diving attachments or dinghy attachments. Gunports where specified are empty structural openings, never cannons. Do not add detachable platform railings; integral solid hull bulwarks are allowed. No water, sea, dock, sky, backdrop, text, labels, symbols or watermark.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, not a checkerboard image.
These are design images, not executable 3D models or approved final ship balancing.
